annotations.rationale: grad_accum_dtype buffer must equal model_dtype. Precond: ZeRO enabled + grad_accum_dtype unset. P4 over P1 because reading the optimizer-internal buffer dtype needs a runtime hook, not standard trace.

Two boundary flags must be equal at allreduce_gradients entry. Precond: PP+ZeRO active. P7 (counter/flag check). Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: control_flow because root cause is a flag never being propagated, not the reduction op (anti-example 3).

len(dataloader) must equal a deterministic function of sampler length and batch_size. Single-rank check, no topology, no module attr — schema_only. Tier exceeds_tier6 because dataloader.len is not in the standard trace tier list. P1 because it is a single-field equality vs known formula.

Buffer dtype must equal configured grad_accum_dtype. Per anti-example 1, even pure-dtype bugs need a precond (which buffer, when configured to bf16). Single-rank but precond on config attr → schema_topo_precond. P4: hook reads optimizer attr, not in default trace.

extra_large_param_to_reduce must be None when contiguous_gradients=False. Precond on that config. P7 (state-flag check). Tier exceeds_tier6: optimizer-internal attr not in tiers. Borderline gradient_sync vs control_flow: control_flow because bug is a stale flag (anti-example 3).

Detection requires reference (DP=N, EP=1) vs (EP=ep) parity comparison. No single-run field exposes missing ep_size scale. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. moe over numerical because scale is AutoEP-specific.

Wrong divisor (edp vs dp) detectable only via matched (EP=1) reference. No standalone field exposes scaling error. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. moe over numerical because divisor logic is EP-specific.
locations must equal cumsum(mask)-1 (algebraic relation). Precond: drop_tokens=False branch + capacity update fired. P2. Tier exceeds_tier6: op-level intermediates not in standard trace.

After load, ds_secondary_tensor must equal slice of refreshed ds_tensor. Precond: ZeRO++ hierarchical partitioning. P7 (per-module freshness flag). Tier 0 (param checksum). Stage=checkpoint_load per anti-example 7.

Intermediate-value precision loss in CUDA kernel; output tensor has correct dtype/shape. No runtime field distinguishes 'fp32 with 13 mantissa bits truncated' from normal fp32. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Hard-coded constant in C++ kernel — runtime cannot observe the divisor used inside the .so. Reduced gradient values do reflect the bug but indistinguishable from other comm errors without a parity reference. Effectively source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

After load, distinct global DP ranks have identical partition checksums when they should differ — cross-rank divergence visible at load. Precond: multi-node ZeRO-3 + universal checkpoint. P3 (cross-rank pattern). Tier 0 (param checksum).

After has_overflow, overflow flag and loss_scale must agree across DP ranks (cross-rank replication). Precond: ZeRO stage 1 + fp16 dynamic loss scaler. P3 because the bug is detected as values that should be equal across DP ranks but aren't. Tier 3 (loss_scale is a control variable).

At Adam.step entry, grad dtype must equal partition dtype (fp32). Precond: BF16_Optimizer + grad_acc_dtype=bf16. P4 because dtype check on optimizer-internal partition needs a runtime hook (not standard trace). Tier 0 (dtype field).

Bug is non-idempotent C++ counter logic across subgroup calls; betta_t values inside DeepSpeedCPUAdam kernel are not exposed to Python. Difference is sub-ULP floating-point. Source-only: must read the IncrementStep cpp branch logic. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

On non-last PP stages, hp_grad must equal exactly one cast of lp.grad (not 2x). Precond: PP>1 + bf16 + immediate_grad_update=True. P5 because detection compares hp_grad scale/value to lp.grad — gradient norm/scale boundary check via hook. Tier 1 (gradient stats).

Cached per-param L2 norm must match current grad's recomputed norm after set_local_grad. Precond: ZeRO-3 + CPU offload + safe_set_local_grad call. P5 (gradient norm boundary). Tier 1 (gradient stats). value_equality because cached norm should equal recomputed norm.

When autocast(fp16)+ZeRO-0, a non-trivial loss_scale must be installed. Precond: specific config combo. P7 because it is a missing-flag/state-counter check on the engine (no GradScaler attached). Tier 3 (loss_scale is a control variable).

Stream-synchronization race: requires CUDA stream/event timeline observation, not exposed in any standard trace. Manifests as nondeterministic gradient corruption only in some windows. Effectively source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. invariant_type=other (sync ordering).

Symmetric with D-NEW-68: missing wait_stream(reduction_stream) on current stream. Detection requires CUDA stream timing knowledge — not in any tier. Source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Buffer passed to average_tensor must be narrow(0,0,elements_in_ipg_bucket); detectable as a length-mismatch hook. Precond: contiguous_gradients=True + bucket flushed early. P5 because grad-buffer scope/size check before allreduce. Tier exceeds_tier6 (ipg_buffer length is not in tier list).

Padding bytes appended before reduce_scatter must equal zero. Precond: ZeRO-3 + last partition shorter. P5 (grad-buffer pre-comm check). Tier exceeds_tier6: padding-byte tail values are not a standard trace field.

Reshape collapses batch/seq dims wrongly. Detection requires running a roundtrip identity test (run reference inverse and compare element-wise) — implementation_equivalence parity. No single-run trace field reveals the wrong reshape. Source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Two backward paths (engine.backward vs scale_loss().backward) should yield identical expert weights — pure parity (implementation_equivalence). No single-run field exposes the missing ep_size multiply. Per anti-example 9: source-only → pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Per-rank NVMe save paths must be unique across DP ranks (set-completeness). Cross-rank uniqueness check, no module-attr precond. schema_topo (no precond needed). P3 cross-rank. Tier exceeds_tier6 (filesystem path not in trace tiers).

After CPU Adam step every element of every multi-dim param must change. Single-rank check on parameter checksum/per-element diff. schema_only because no precond and no cross-rank needed. P1 (single-field equality with prior-state). Tier 0 (parameter checksum suffices).

Bug is tracking an init-time broadcast through autograd. Detection needs walking the autograd graph after backward to find the broadcast op — no standard trace exposes grad_fn structure. Effectively source-only: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.
Stream-synchronization race for ZeRO++ secondary partition copy — same family as D-NEW-68/69. Source-only stream timing bug; pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

allreduce input dtype must equal configured communication_data_type. Precond: ZeRO + bf16 + user comm dtype. P4 (transient comm tensor needs hook). Tier 0 (dtype). Borderline dtype vs communication: dtype because surface is a wrong dtype kwarg default.

After scheduler construction, optimizer's group lr must equal scheduler.get_lr()[0]. Single-rank, single-field equality check at init — no module attr precond. schema_only. P1 (trace field equality vs determined value). Tier 3 (lr is a control variable).

Per-(group,rank) padding count must match formula. Precond: ZeRO 1/2 + large DP. P7 (per-rank module state). Tier exceeds_tier6: padding bookkeeping not in tiers. Borderline checkpoint vs control_flow: checkpoint because corruption surfaces in optimizer save/load.

After accumulate_hp_grads_and_remove_lp, lp_grads must be cleared (==0). Precond: BF16_Optimizer in accumulation phase. P7 (state-flag check). Tier 1 (gradient stats). Borderline gradient_sync vs optimizer_state: optimizer_state because buffer is optimizer-owned.

Embedding grad checksum on PP[0] vs PP[-1] within same DP group must match after finalize_model_grads. Precond: distributed_optimizer + share_embeddings_and_output_weights. P3 (cross-rank equality with replication). Tier 1 (grad stats).

Detection requires running a single-GPU reference and comparing dQ/dK/dV gradients (relative error >1.0). No standalone runtime field reveals the bug. Per anti-example 9, parity-based detection is source-only/source-analysis — pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Loss multiplied by cp_size only visible against non-CP reference. No single-rank field exposes wrong scale. Source-only parity detection — pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6 per anti-example 9.

MTP loss not divided by num_tokens — manifests as abnormally large loss/grad-norm. Precond: per-token-loss=True + MTP. P5 (grad-norm boundary). Tier 2 (loss). Borderline P1 vs P5: P5 because signal is a magnitude bound, not equality to a constant.

Router weights must be identical across TP ranks. Precond: TP-replicated (not sharded) param + GPU init. Rule depends on TP attr (anti-example 2). P3 cross-rank. Tier 6 (RNG state). Borderline sharding vs control_flow: control_flow per mapping (init → control_flow).

Non-divisible vocab_size produces systematically divergent loss only against single-GPU reference. No single-run field exposes the bug — manifests as small drift. Source-only parity. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Param checksum at forward must reflect current iteration, not previous. Precond: --overlap-param-gather + bucket order != forward order. Detection: equality of param checksum with this-step expected vs prev-step. P1 (trace-field equality). Tier 0 (parameter checksum).

After warmup lr must be > 0 and loss must trend down; found_inf permanently True is the bug signature. Precond: fp16 + distributed_optimizer + overlap flags. P7 (counter/flag state). Tier 3 (lr is a control variable). Borderline P5 vs P7: P7 because primary signal is a flag state, not a magnitude.

Q/K/V not all-gathered before flash attention. Detection requires SP vs non-SP reference comparison; output tensor still has correct shape/dtype. Source-only parity bug — pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Function call count must equal 1 per (step,layer,loss_name). Precond: moe-layer-recompute + aux-coeff>0. P7 (call-counter check). Tier exceeds_tier6: call counters not in tiers. Borderline moe vs control_flow: control_flow (double-counting in recompute, not MoE math).

RoPE values are computed from positions 0..N regardless of input position_ids — detection needs comparing RoPE output to expected from given position_ids. Op-level intermediate, not in any tier. Source-only parity bug — pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

expert_bias buffer must be fp32 in routing. Precond: registered fp32 buffer attribute on TopKRouter + Float16Module wrapping. P4 (hook reads module attr/buffer dtype). Tier 0 (dtype). Per anti-example 1, dtype bug needs precond — schema_topo_precond.

Aux loss must vary, not stay constant 1.0. Precond: seq_aux_loss + pad_to_capacity. P5 (boundary check on aux loss magnitude/variability). Tier 2 (loss value). Borderline numerical vs moe: numerical because root-cause is the routing_map padding math; both acceptable.

topk=1 then softmax gives prob==1.0 always; router gradient is zero. Precond: topk=1 + post-softmax. P5 (boundary check that router grads aren't trivially zero). Tier 1 (gradient stats reveal it). Borderline numerical vs moe: numerical because it is a math-ordering bug.

After resume with --override-opt_param-scheduler, lr must equal new override, not checkpoint value. Precond: override flag set + checkpoint loaded. P1 (trace-field equality vs configured value). Tier 3 (lr). Per category mapping, scheduler → lr_schedule.

Loss continuity bound across save/resume. Precond: --use-precision-aware-optimizer + --optimizer-cpu-offload. P5 (loss-magnitude boundary). Tier 2 (loss). Per anti-example 7, stage is checkpoint_load.
Loss continuity across checkpoint save/load. Precond: mcore-0.12.0 path. P5 (loss boundary). Tier 2 (loss value sufficient signal). check_stage=checkpoint_load per anti-example 7.

RNG/dropout consistency across DP ranks but distinct across TP ranks. Precond: data-parallel vs model-parallel seed semantics. P3 (cross-rank equality with topology guard). Tier 6 (RNG state). Borderline category sharding vs control_flow: control_flow per mapping for init/seed bugs.

All embedding wgrad contributions must be included before all-reduce (ordering completeness). Precond: PP enabled + shared embeddings. P7 because it is a stage/flag-counter check (finish_embedding_wgrad_compute order). Tier 1 (gradient stats).

Total transformer layers across PP ranks must equal configured num_layers — build-time named_modules cross-rank set check. Precond: PP>1 + non-divisible. P8 (build-time static assertion). Tier 6 (named_modules snapshot). control_flow (integer division silently drops layers).
Expert params must agree across same expert-DP subgroup after step. Precond: distributed_optimizer + MoE + EP active. P3 cross-rank. Tier 0 (param checksum).
softmax_factor must equal mscale_all_dim, not mscale. Precond: MLA path. P1 (single field equality vs known constant). Tier exceeds_tier6: softmax_factor is op-level intermediate, not in tier list.

p2p tensor shape must match real activation shape with CP enabled. Precond: PP+CP combined. P6 because the bug is a topology-aware shape check (group/topology config). Tier 0 (shape). Borderline category sharding vs communication: communication because the failure is in p2p send/recv shape.
apply_input_jitter output dtype must equal input dtype. Precond: bf16/fp16 mixed precision + jitter-eps>0 + MoE TopKRouter. P4 (op-input dtype hook, anti-example 1 pattern). Tier 0 (dtype).

Detection compares master weights to a direct-init-in-params_dtype reference. Small numerical drift only. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. Borderline dtype vs numerical: numerical (init-precision drift, not wrong dtype value).

DDP bucket params must equal source params after init. Precond: DDP + multi-stream init. P7 because it is an init-time state snapshot/sync flag check. Tier 0 (param checksum). Per anti-example 10, init stage (runtime, not build-time).

sample_idx must be monotonic; int32 overflow visible as wraparound. Single-rank field check, no precond. schema_only. P1 (single-field bound). Tier exceeds_tier6: dataloader internal not in tiers. Borderline data_loading vs control_flow: control_flow per mapping.

RoPE position split across CP ranks may not match correct positions. Detection requires comparing per-rank embeddings to a non-CP reference. Source-only parity. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

torch.compile recompile-limit + c10d::broadcast_ in autograd graph — detection requires walking grad_fn and reading torch.compile internal counters, neither in any tier. Source-only. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

First resumed-step lr must equal newly configured value, not checkpoint value. Precond: --override-opt_param-scheduler + checkpoint loaded. P1 (single field equality). Tier 3 (lr control variable). Sibling of M-015. Per category mapping, scheduler → lr_schedule (over checkpoint).

Loss not NaN under MXFP8 + reuse_grad_buf without overlap flags. Precond: --fp8-param-gather + --reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag + no overlap. P5 (loss/grad-buffer boundary). Tier 2 (loss). Borderline gradient_sync vs communication: communication because root cause is comm-overlap interaction.
MLA produces abnormal loss only against non-MLA reference. No standalone field exposes the bug. Source-only parity. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

Global aux loss gradient too small by 1/dp_size — visible only against per-DP reference (parity). The wrong scale in normalize_scale is purely source-level. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6 per anti-example 9.

Stream-affinity race in DDP post-hook → reduce-scatter races hook completion. Detection requires CUDA stream tracing; race is non-deterministic. Source-only per anti-example 9: pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.
TE fused attention backward bug — visible only against non-fused reference. No standalone runtime field exposes it. Source-only/parity. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

TE silently ignores block-diag mask, defaults to causal. Detection requires comparing attention output to block-diag-masked reference. Source-only parity. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

YarnRotaryEmbedding instantiated without rotary_interleaved arg — half-half layout vs interleaved logic mismatch. Detectable only via reference comparison. Source-only. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.
MTP loss gradient missing cp_size compensation — visible only via parity. Pure source-level scale bug. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6 per anti-example 9.

MoE gate must be sliced across TP when kv_head < tp_size. Static assertion at build (named_modules attr inspection). Precond: kv_head < tp_size + MoE active. P8 because the wrong gate shape is determined at module construction time. Tier 0 (shape).
On first iteration grad buffer must be zero before backward. Precond: reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag + forward_pre_hook disabled. P5 (gradient buffer pre-state check). Tier 1 (gradient stats).

After eval→train transition, dropout_p must be restored to configured value (not 0). Precond: model.eval() called and then model.train(). P7 because it is a state-counter/flag bug (dropout_p never restored). Tier exceeds_tier6: dropout_p is op-level attr, not in standard tiers.

Optimizer state must contain exp_avg/exp_avg_sq keys at save time (set completeness, anti-example 12). Precond: save-interval=20 + early-step save. P7 (state-completeness flag). Tier 4 (optimizer state checksum).

When output_gate=True, gate.shape[2] must equal heads_per_partition per TP rank. Precond: output_gate + num_query_groups<tp_size. P8 (shape fixed at module ctor). Tier 0 (shape). Borderline numerical vs sharding: sharding (missing per-TP slicing).

FusedAdam.use_decoupled_grad must be True under Megatron-FSDP, and at least one param must have non-zero decoupled_grad. Precond: use_megatron_fsdp + use_precision_aware_optimizer. P7 (state-flag check on optimizer). Tier 1 (gradient stats).

After CUDA-graph warmup, persistent buffers (expert_bias) must equal pre-warmup values bitwise. Precond: aux-loss-free MoE + CUDA graphs enabled. P7 (per-module persistent-buffer state check). Tier 6 (named_parameters/persistent buffer snapshot needed).

When fp8 and fp4 both False, permute() must not pad: token count == sum(tokens_per_expert). Precond: non-quantized model. P2 (algebraic relation between two trace fields). Tier exceeds_tier6: token-count internals not in tier list.

After dispatch_param_gather, param_gather_dispatched must be True. Precond: layerwise distributed optimizer + expt_dp_size==1 + MoE. P7 (state-flag/counter check). Tier exceeds_tier6: param_gather_dispatched is optimizer-internal not in tier list.

Under Megatron-FSDP + precision-aware optimizer, FusedAdam.master_weights must be False. Precond: both flags True. P7 (optimizer state flag). Tier exceeds_tier6 (FusedAdam master_weights internal flag).

After bucket finish_param_sync, no other bucket's param_data should be zeroed. Precond: reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag + overlap_param_gather + multiple buckets. P5 (grad-buffer reuse boundary check). Tier 0 (param checksum).

If weight has __fsdp_param__, main_grad after backward must equal get_main_grad(). Precond: Megatron-FSDP + grad_accum_fusion + FSDP DTensor. P4: hook reads runtime-derived module attribute (get_main_grad()). Tier 1 (gradient stats).

FusedAdam master_weights flag must equal config.use_precision_aware_optimizer_no_fp8_or_ds_fp8. Precond: bf16 main params + precision-aware optimizer + no FP8. P7 (config/state-flag equality). Tier exceeds_tier6 (master_weights config attr not in tier list).

expert_bias added before sigmoid distorts probs. Detection requires reference computation: sigmoid(logits) gathered at top_indices vs the buggy form. Pure source-only ordering bug. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6 per anti-example 9. Same family as D-NEW-1.
calculate_per_token_loss + CP misses cp_size factor. Detection needs comparing scaled_loss formula across the two flags — purely source-level scale bug. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

_handle_tensor_list used sum() instead of mean(). Detection requires reference (mean) vs buggy (sum) comparison; encoder grad still has correct shape/dtype. Source-only scale bug. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6.

expert_gradient_scaling_factor wrong when DP != EDP. Detection needs ratio comparison against reference 1/dp_size. Source-only scale bug visible only via parity. Pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6 per anti-example 9.

topk k must equal num_groups//group_topk, not hardcoded 2. Single-field equality vs configured constant. Precond: moe_router_group_topk set + num_groups configured. P1 (single field equality vs known formula). Tier exceeds_tier6: k value is op-internal kwarg.

After Router.__init__ with perform_initialization=False, weights must be identical across DP ranks (or not re-randomized). Precond: that flag + MoE router. P3 cross-rank. Tier 0 (param checksum). Borderline control_flow vs moe: moe (router-specific).

expert_bias dtype must remain fp32 each forward, not bf16. Precond: bf16/fp16 + Float16Module wrapping + MoE router. P4 (hook reads buffer dtype). Tier 0 (dtype). Sibling of M-012; same family — both qualify under anti-example 1.

MambaStack layer offsets must equal get_transformer_layer_offset under uneven PP. Precond: hybrid Mamba + uneven PP config. P8: built at module construction time (named_modules class snapshot). Tier 6 (named_modules snapshot needed).
